subject: Neighborhood and Urban Residential Zoning Updates
overview: The City Council Planning and Permitting Committee met to review updated proposals and draft text for the Neighborhood and Urban Residential zoning ordinance. The committee voted to refer the draft zoning proposal to the regular City Council meeting for subsequent referral to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Roll Call and Call to Order
items.summary: The meeting was called to order and the roll was called.

items.title: Presentation of Residential Zoning Proposal
items.summary: Innes Associates presented the updated neighborhood and urban residential zoning proposal, outlining district classifications, residential typologies, and proposed dimensional standards.

items.title: Discussion on Accessory Dwelling Units
items.summary: The committee and consultants discussed how state laws and local zoning regulations govern accessory dwelling units within single-family and multi-family residential districts.

items.title: Review of Dimensional and Development Standards
items.summary: The consultants detailed proposed density limits, building heights, setbacks, and open space requirements for the new residential subdistricts.

items.title: Protection of Existing Non-Conforming Structures
items.summary: The committee reviewed existing zoning protections to ensure current single-family homeowners in newly designated urban residential zones can perform renovations without undue permitting burdens.

items.title: Public Comment
items.summary: Residents and community members offered feedback and asked questions regarding neighborhood density, property values, historic preservation, infrastructure capacity, and affordable housing.

items.title: Referral of Draft Proposal and Adjournment
items.summary: The committee approved a motion to refer the draft residential zoning proposal to the regular City Council meeting and adjourned.
